mission.title: Incoming
mission.description: Deliver the Machine mainframe code-named Ivkovic to the Merovingian's technicians so its data can reach the General.

npc.say:
Where did that attack come from? Corporal, status report! Corporal! Blast it...
Ensign! Find me an officer who's still functional! And shut off that damn broadca--

phase.briefing:
Our seeding of the Dark Storm appears to have worked--better than expected, in fact. We've kicked up quite a maelstrom out there, and with radio waves curving through the large temperature inversion between us and the General, he's coming in loud and clear.
Whether or not this is a good thing is another question, perhaps... At any rate, our job now is to feed him Machine data that will help his Sentinels decrypt the information they're pulling out of the Oligarch Network.
We had a bit of a time finding the correct data type before, but our technicians have been doing more research on it in the interim, and they've already got a fresh source identified. They tell me this Machine mainframe is code-named "Ivkovic."

enter.say:
Weird ident for a mainframe.
Let's see... I'm reading a large data source in there; that'd be the mainframe, probably. Nothing that looks like Machine security.
I heard the Machines are gunning pretty hard for some Zion operative named "Mauser." Sounds kind of familiar... Didn't we look up a Zionite with a name like that last year? Anyway, maybe that's why they don't have any guards on this mainframe right now.

talk.say: What--? Who are you? I don't understand!

done.say: They're on to you! Grab her and take off!

objective.text: Lead Ivkovic out of the area

near.say: *That's* the mainframe? Uh... Okay... This might complicate things. We'd better get her--it--whatever--out of there.

phase.briefing: If the mainframe has legs, then you'd better get them moving, operative. We've got to get them plugged in and uploaded immediately.

enter.say:
Okay, get them to the computer in there. We've got techs standing by to hook them up and download whatever data they've got.
... This is still sort of weird.

talk.say: Who are you? Why are you doing this?
Y-yes. I'll just a-activate the procedure, shall I? O-oh!

done.say: The technician's down! Get that Agent!
Okay. You're gonna have to start the download. Activate the computer over there.
Who are you? Why are you doing this?
More Machines! Keep them away from her--I mean, the mainframe!

complete.say: The download seems to be doing okay. Let's check with Flood and see if we're good to go.

phase.briefing: The specialized data from that mainframe's brain should be winging its way to the General right now. Get in touch with him and confirm that we've pampered him sufficiently.

enter.say: They're getting a broadcast set up in there.

talk.say:
Yes, we've succeeded in re-opening the connection to the foreign network. We expect to start sending captured data shortly.
There has been no trouble from the Machines. Our scans have not detected them within the demarcated zone, but the increase in storm activity has reduced our visibility range. We'll continue to-- What?!
Incoming missiles! Cover! Prepare to return fire!

done.say: Missiles? You mean they're under attack? Uh-oh...

Where did that attack come from? Corporal, status report! Corporal! Blast it...
Ensign! Find me an officer who's still functional! And shut off that damn broadca--

phase.briefing:
What? Said something about missiles? But he was still alive, obviously... To blazes with the man's infernal luck!
Mm... Maybe there'll be a second barrage. Yes, must think positive.
...And in a strange coincidence, the data flow from the Ivkovic mainframe has stopped. I thought we'd moved her to a more secure facility. {player}, go check on this, please.

enter.say: Not reading any activity in there. I'll try to keep an eye out for Machines.

done.say: ... She was a good little mainframe...

mission.finish:
Yes, yes... But the General could be dead, operative, and at least that's worth celebrating. It isn't as though we need him, after all--any one of his officers could almost certainly do a less incompetent job than him.
Hm... We'll have to see if we can scrounge one of them up.
